data.name: ZeoDAC
data.description: ZeoDAC is a Caltech/Georgia Tech spinout founded in June 2023 by Professors Christopher Jones and Mark E. Davis, commercializing an amine-free, zeolite-based Direct Air Capture process under exclusive license to Caltech IP. Backed by Wilson Hill Ventures, Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, Freeflow Ventures, and Global Brain, and based at Georgia Tech's ATDC in Atlanta.
